pagina.alcance: The draft stays in this tab. Download it before leaving; files are not sent.
pagina.cerrado: Identification and submission are not connected yet. This preparation does not register an application.
pagina.error: The notice could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
pagina.invalida: Open a published recruitment notice to prepare your application.
pagina.no_fuente: The public notice is unavailable. Return to the list or try again later.
pagina.descargado: The summary has been generated for download. The application remains unsubmitted.
pagina.ayuda_texto: Review the published rules, requirements and deadlines. You can choose optional files and download a summary. Leaving discards your preparation. The summary is not proof of submission, signature or registration.

convocatoria.sin_plazos: No public deadlines are listed. Check the rules.
convocatoria.sin_requisitos: No public requirements are listed. Check the rules.
convocatoria.sin_documentos: No associated public documents are listed.
convocatoria.pendiente: Compliance has not been checked. Requirements are displayed as published.
convocatoria.lectura: I have reviewed the published requirements, deadlines and documents.
convocatoria.lectura_error: Review the information and tick the box to continue.

archivos.ayuda: Choosing files does not attach them to an application. Check the rules for the documents you must submit.
archivos.limite: Up to {cuenta} files, each no larger than {tamano} MiB. These limits apply to this local preparation.
archivos.seleccionar: Choose or replace the file list (optional)
archivos.sin_archivos: You have not chosen any files. You can continue without them.
archivos.cantidad_error: Too many files selected. Choose no more than {limite}.
archivos.tamano_error: A file exceeds the size limit. Choose files no larger than {limite} MiB.
archivos.nombre_error: A file has an invalid name. Rename it and choose it again.
archivos.datos_error: The file information could not be read. Choose the files again.
archivos.descarga_aviso: The summary includes only names and sizes. Keep the original files for submission.

resumen.lectura: Published information reviewed by the applicant
resumen.contenido: The download will include the notice reference, its version, the published requirements and deadlines, and the names of your chosen files.
resumen.limite: This draft is not an acknowledgement or a receipt. It is not proof of signature, registration or submission.
